key_idea: Enumerate the subset of days (2^7); for a fixed day set the best hours are simply the h columns with the most free cells.
sketch: Picking more than the minimum never helps on the inner choice: the average of the top-k column counts is non-increasing in k, so take exactly h hours. For the outer choice just enumerate all 127 day subsets with at least d days. For each, count free cells per hour over the chosen days, sort descending, sum the top h and divide by |days|*h. Complexity 2^7 * 7 * 24. Pitfall: do not greedily take the d best days first; the day/hour choices interact, hence the enumeration.
